# Test fixtures

- `clips/` holds the fixture clips. It is git-ignored, as are all video files anywhere in
  the repo. `hands_leave` is the user's own recording (Q11). `hands_visible` is a local
  5-second excerpt of a public-domain video from Wikimedia Commons, with its source file
  kept beside it; see `docs/DATA_LICENSES.md`. Never put dataset frames or videos here.
- Tiny synthetic arrays may be committed here.
